Article.title: Port of Rotterdam sets new container record
Article.summary: Container throughput hit an all-time high this quarter.
Article.body: The Port of Rotterdam handled more containers this quarter than in any previous quarter, driven by rebounding trade routes from Asia.

Article.title: New emissions rules for bulk carriers take effect
Article.summary: Operators must report fuel use under tighter limits.
Article.body: Starting this month, bulk carriers over 5000 tonnes must report fuel consumption under the revised international emissions framework.

Article.title: Suez Canal traffic returns to pre-disruption levels
Article.summary: Transit volumes recovered after a slow first half of the year.
Article.body: Canal authorities report that daily transits have returned to levels last seen before regional disruptions began.

Company.name: Meridian Shipping Lines
Company.history: Founded in 1974, Meridian grew from a single coastal freighter into a global container carrier operating on six continents.
Company.executives: CEO: Laura Chen; COO: Marcus Webb; CFO: Priya Nair.

Company.name: Northstar Marine Freight
Company.history: Northstar began as a regional bulk carrier in 1998 and now operates a fleet of forty vessels across the Atlantic and Pacific.
Company.executives: CEO: Tomas Reyes; COO: Hannah OSullivan.
